instruction: A tank holds 900 litres of water. First, exactly one third of the water is removed. Then 40 percent of the remaining water is used. Finally, a quarter of what is left is poured out. How many litres of water are in the tank at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
